definitions.gloss: chicken gizzard, especially as a yakitori cut
definitions.explanation: The muscular stomach of a chicken, eaten grilled on skewers or stir-fried. Prized for its firm, crunchy texture rather than for richness of flavor.

examples.japanese: {砂肝|すなぎも}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{二本|にほん}⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧。
{砂肝|すなぎも}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦こりこり→コリコリ：06846_korikori⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{食感|しょっかん}→食感：06636_shokkan⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{好|す}き→好き：02355_suki⟧だ。
examples.english: I like the crunchy texture of chicken gizzard.

notes:
Literally "sand liver," from the grit birds keep in the organ to grind their food. Despite the name it is not liver; {砂肝|すなぎも} and ⟦レバー→レバー：11263_rebaa⟧ are different items on a yakitori menu.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {砂肝|すなぎも}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{塩焼|しおや}き→塩焼き：12120_shioyaki⟧: salt-grilled gizzard
- {砂肝|すなぎも}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦こりこり→コリコリ：06846_korikori⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{食感|しょっかん}→食感：06636_shokkan⟧: the crunchy texture of gizzard
- {砂肝|すなぎも}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{串|くし}→串：19339_kushi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{刺|さ}す→刺す：02111_sasu⟧: to put gizzard on a skewer

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {砂嚢|さのう}: gizzard — the anatomical term, not used on menus
- ⟦レバー→レバー：11263_rebaa⟧: liver — soft and rich, the usual point of contrast on a yakitori order
